purpose: Purchase-candidate-only, zero-shot TSFM daily remaining-upside forecasting versus selected-trade age prior and a two-volatility stochastic OHLC baseline
entry_models: Existing eight C models and E124 frozen buy cohort unchanged
buy_rule: Base three classifier frozen percentiles all>=95, daily top2, selected before price/ranking quality exclusions; hypothetical purchases, no three-slot portfolio constraint
fit_population: No non-purchase labels, no TSFM fine tuning, no fitted probability calibration; age prior uses only215 complete selected trades matured before2025-11-01
decision: Close of purchase sessions1..19; next-session open for discretionary sale; original session20 close deadline
arrival: Future intraday high touches original purchase_price*(1+target); already-arrived status not scored as a future prediction

tsfm.target: For remaining r=20-k, construct past r-session rolling maxima of adjusted intraday high, take log(relative to the known current close), forecast r sessions, and use the final marginal distribution. Its target is exactly max of future sessions k+1..20, not max of daily marginal forecast quantiles.
tsfm.postprocessing: Sort crossing quantiles. Primary complete approximate quantile function has constant tails at endpoint quantiles (winsorized tails); price-linear quantile endpoint extrapolation is sensitivity only, never selected on outer outcomes.
outputs: future high mean and standard deviation under declared tail approximation

baselines.age_prior: For each elapsed day and target, unarrived selected past trades only; (hits+1)/(n+2), frozen prior cutoff2025-11-01; no broader candidates
baselines.volatility: 4096 simulated OHLC paths from known current close. Overnight log gaps N(0,sigma_gap^2), intraday log close/open N(0,sigma_intraday^2), conditional intraday Brownian-bridge high. Sixty past market sessions only; sigma_gap sample variance of gaps, sigma_intraday Parkinson H/L variance. No drift fitting or purchase-label fitting.

inference_isolation: Verify individual versus batched forecasts before full inference; never mix different query states through cross-series learning
common_cohort: All fixed61 purchases, all19 close landmarks. Predeclare exclusions for insufficient context/vol history before forecasting; any forecast failure must stop or be reported, not selectively remove outcomes.
scores: Unarrived-landmark Brier/logloss and day buckets; trade-equal diagnostic; mean/median future-high error and quantile coverage; all comparisons on identical rows
confidence: 21-market-session moving blocks of purchase signal dates,2000 draws, seed123; keep each trade's rows together; simulation paths do not increase number of observed trades
exit_primary: Fixed +10/+15 limit and original20-day deadline; discretionary next-open exit if current remaining arrival probability is below0.20
exit_secondary: First purchase-day-close prediction is reference; from session2 close onward, discretionary next-open sale if remaining arrival probability falls below half that reference; fixed target/deadline unchanged
exit_parameters: No selection or optimization on61 outer trades; two simple rules declared before new TSFM forecasts
fills: Profit gaps capped at target, discretionary sale capped identically for comparison; actual opening-price profit gaps sensitivity. Deadline predetermined. No stop in primary policies.
known_limits: The same historical period has been viewed in E121-E124, so this remains exploratory, not fresh future confirmation
61 purchases,58 tickers,43 signal dates are not all independent; probability calibration cannot be established by simulated paths
TSFM is generic pretrained forecasting, not trained to know Japanese breakout selection or earnings shocks
Endpoint-tail assumptions affect the mean and standard deviation; report sensitivity rather than call these known expectations
E124 full-pool-rank/price-complete conditional cohort and original data revisions are inherited; four excluded purchases remain unassessed
The two-volatility baseline assumes independent Gaussian gaps/intraday returns and constant near-term volatility
Daily bars and simplified fills omit order-book liquidity, taxes, dividends and capital constraints
